xref.title: Serial Entrepreneur
xref.body: Beyond his role as frontman for Five Finger Death Punch, Ivan Moody is a serial entrepreneur. His ventures include Moody's Medicinals, a CBD company, and Moody's Rock Stop, a gas station in Cheyenne, Wyoming, located on West Pershing Boulevard, that also sells bait. "He's already something of a serial entrepreneur."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
